title: RIECNN: Real-Time Image Enhanced CNN for Traffic Sign Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.15127v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traffic sign recognition plays a crucial role in the development of autonomous cars to reduce the accident rate and promote road safety. It has been a necessity to address traffic signs that are affected significantly by the environment as well as poor real-time performance for deep-learning state-of-the-art algorithms. In this paper, we introduce Real-Time Image Enhanced CNN ({\our}) for Traffic Sign Recognition. {\our} is a real-time, novel approach that tackles multiple, diverse traffic sign datasets, and out-performs the state-of-the-art architectures in terms of recognition rate and execution time. Experiments are conducted using the German Traffic Sign Benchmark (GTSRB), the Belgium Traffic Sign Classification (BTSC), and the Croatian Traffic Sign (rMASTIF) benchmark. Experimental results show that our approach has achieved the highest recognition rate for all Benchmarks, achieving a recognition accuracy of 99.75\% for GTSRB, 99.

translated_title: RIECNN：用于交通标志识别的实时图像增强卷积神经网络
translated_abstract: 交通标志识别在自动驾驶汽车的发展中起着至关重要的作用，可以降低事故发生率并促进道路安全。解决受环境显著影响的交通标志问题以及现有最先进深度学习算法实时性差的问题，已成为必然需求。本文提出了一种用于交通标志识别的实时图像增强卷积神经网络（RIECNN）。该方法是一种实时的新颖方法，能够处理多个不同的交通标志数据集，并在识别率和执行时间方面超越最先进的架构。实验使用了德国交通标志基准数据集（GTSRB）、比利时交通标志分类数据集（BTSC）和克罗地亚交通标志基准数据集进行。实验结果表明，该方法在所有基准数据集上都取得了最高的识别率，在GTSRB上达到了99.75%的识别准确率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种实时图像增强卷积神经网络RIECNN，能够处理多种不同的交通标志数据集，在识别率和执行时间上均超越现有最先进方法，并在多个基准数据集上取得最高识别率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RIECNN, a real-time image-enhanced CNN for traffic sign recognition that outperforms state-of-the-art architectures in both recognition rate and execution time across multiple benchmark datasets.
